arc.energy_shape_notes: Exposition, fracture, toggle. Bright C# major groove for ~5min, a fracture section of dropouts bracketing the track's loudest spike (-9.1dB at 265s), a short deep valley (-19.8dB at 280s, bare G#), then the C# third-toggle vamp from ~300s to the end played at volume, with a pre-finale dip (-17.1dB at 560s) launching the final climb to -9.7dB at 615s and a hard stop at full volume. No comedown; ends on the minor side of the toggle.

generator_hints.bass: root-driven low end; finale darkens to ~2760Hz centroid while level peaks

harmony.home_scale: C# major (C# D# F F# G# A# C), I-IV-V-ii, for 0-270s; then C# third-toggle vamp: static C# root, third alternates E (minor) <-> F (major) with both sounding at once; detector flips C# maj <-> C# min every 30s window from 420s on. Ends on the minor side.
signature_devices: Third-toggle vamp: static C# root, alternate major/minor 3rd (E<->F). Detector flips maj/min every 30s from 420s (7 flips, conf. 0.56-0.79); chroma keeps both thirds sounding (E mean 0.45, F mean 0.39). Tension via third-ambiguity, not functional motion. Same device family as ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS' Db toggle, new root.
Bare-dominant valley moment: at 270s chroma collapses to G# alone (0.79, everything else <=0.40) in the deepest valley window.
No V-i cadence, no leading tone, no return to stable major after 300s - never resolve.
Four-on-the-floor grid at 143.6 BPM, verified by downbeat spacing ~1.65s, present from the first second (first downbeat 0.98s).

Fracture section 210-270s: dropouts at 220-225s and 250s (-18.4dB) with full-level material slamming back between them, then the track's loudest spike (-9.1dB at 265s) right before the valley. Hole -> slam -> hole -> spike.
Pre-finale dip as launchpad: ~6dB drop in one window (-10.9dB at 555s -> -17.1dB at 560s) immediately before the final climb.
Per-minute 99.4 BPM misread at 180-240s is a tracker artifact in the sparse fracture texture, not a tempo change.

tempo.feel: four-on-the-floor at 143.6 BPM, rock-stable, grid present from 0.98s. Fracture section interrupts the groove with dropouts but the grid returns every time; second half holds volume through the toggle vamp with no further tempo deviation.

timbre.palette_notes: Brightest of the pair: mean centroid 3412Hz, rolloff 6877Hz, ZCR 0.142 (noisier than HOW TO LOVE at 0.111). Brightest at the start (3890Hz first minute), darkening to ~2760Hz by 600s as level peaks - light in, weight out. Valley is the noisiest moment (ZCR 0.302 at 280s) exactly where the level is lowest. Bandwidth mean 2928Hz, wider than HOW TO LOVE. Final 5s window (620s) is an edge artifact and is not used.
